ambiguities.text: The specific FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER for mainnet activation is not specified in the EIP text
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fork block is defined by the London hard fork coordination and network-specific configuration.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'noticeable effects' of the difficulty bomb is subjective and not quantified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'noticeable' means block times consistently exceeding target by a measurable margin (e.g., >15 seconds average).

implicit_assumptions.description: The 9.7 million block offset is calibrated correctly to delay effects until approximately December 2021
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Difficulty bomb could activate earlier or later than intended, disrupting network operations

implicit_assumptions.description: All network participants will upgrade to clients implementing EIP-3554 before the fork block
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain split between upgraded and non-upgraded nodes with different difficulty calculations

implicit_assumptions.description: Network hashrate will remain relatively stable, allowing the delay timing estimate to hold
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Major hashrate swings could cause bomb effects to be felt earlier or later than December 2021

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethereum community will coordinate another delay or transition to PoS before bomb effects become severe
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could become unusable if bomb is allowed to continue increasing difficulty
